user.title: FarmHub
user.description: The address of the FarmHub service and its shared bearer token. The token authenticates Home Assistant to FarmHub; FarmHub decides what each satellite may do.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach FarmHub at that address. Check that the service is running and that the address is reachable from Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This FarmHub service is already configured.
